{'text': '民主黨策略師 Julie Roginsky 星期二表示，曾經係總統 Donald Trump 親密盟友、而家已經被撤換嘅美國駐希臘大使 Kimberly Guilfoyle，被要求辭職係因為佢違反咗「特朗普陣營」最基本嘅戒條之一。'}

{'text': 'Roginsky 喺 Guilfoyle 因被指涉嫌向政府高級官員兜售接觸機會而辭職之後，加入 MS NOW 節目發表評論。事緣同場《On The Line》嘅嘉賓 Eugene Daniels 先講到特朗普只有三條規則：要忠誠、唔好太出名、唔好丟架。', 'paragraph_context': 'Roginsky joined MS NOW after Guilfoyle resigned following allegations that she sold access to senior administration officials, making her case after fellow “On The Line” guest Eugene Daniels said Trump has only three rules: be loyal, be less famous and don’t be an embarrassment.'}

{'text': '「我想喺 Eugene 所講嘅基礎上再加多一個前提，」Roginsky 賣咗個關子。「特朗普陣營嘅第四條規則就係，如果你要撈油水，一定要畀特朗普都有份。而佢喺希臘做緊嘅嘢，明顯係特朗普唔知或者冇份參與嘅。」', 'paragraph_context': '「I would add one more caveat to what Eugene said,」 Roginsky teased. 「There』s a fourth rule of Trump World, which is if you』re going to grift, you can』t grift without Trump being in on it. And she obviously was doing something in Greece that he was not aware of or in on.」'}

{'text': '佢繼續講：「而佢嘅現實就係，佢即將返嚟呢邊。我肯定，喺以保持緘默作為交換條件之下，佢會獲准靠同特朗普家族呢個招牌嘅關係搵吓錢，只不過唔會好似佢想像中咁多。」', 'paragraph_context': 'She continued, 「And the reality of her life is that she』s going to come back here. I』m sure that, in exchange for keeping her mouth shut, she』s going to be allowed to make money off of proximity to her trading a little bit in the Trump family name. Not as much as she』d like to.」'}

{'text': 'Roginsky 指出，Guilfoyle 之前曾經同 Donald Trump Jr. 訂婚，當時佢因為呢層關係可以從中獲利嘅空間大好多。佢之後仲大膽推測，Guilfoyle 唔會再令個家族尷尬，希望藉此保住一條安穩嘅「後路」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Roginsky argued that Guilfoyle, who was previously engaged to Donald Trump Jr., was allowed to profit from that proximity a lot more at the time. She went on to wager that Guilfoyle won』t embarrass the family any further — in hopes of retaining a comfortable 「path」 forward.'}

{'text': 'Roginsky 講：「佢會獲准搵食，呢個就係今次嘅交易。而我預期唔會再聽到佢講任何令家族丟架嘅嘢。佢唔會爆料針對呢個家族，因為佢好清楚，一旦咁做就會被掃出門外。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Roginsky said, 「She』s gonna be allowed to make a living, and that』s going to be the deal. And I don』t expect that we』re gonna hear anything from her that』s going to embarrass her. She』s not going to leak against this family, because she』s going to know that if she does, she』s out.」'}

{'text': 'Guilfoyle 星期一宣布佢嘅大使任期「可能即將結束」，而喺白宮確認要求佺辭職之前唔夠一個鐘。《華爾街日報》早前報導指，佢曾經向一名特朗普嘅金主要求十萬美元，以支付其美國運通卡賬單。', 'paragraph_context': 'Guilfoyle announced Monday that her ambassadorship 「may be coming to an end,」 less than an hour after the White House confirmed it asked her to resign following a Wall Street Journal report that she had asked a Trump donor for $100,000 to pay her American Express bill.'}

{'text': '特朗普星期一喺確認佢「考慮緊」炒掉 Guilfoyle 之後講：「我哋唔高興。」呢位 Maga 領袖入主白宮期間賺咗大錢，但 Roginsky 認為佢只會俾身邊最親近嘅人分一杯羹。', 'paragraph_context': '「We』re not happy,」 Trump said Monday after confirming he was 「looking at」 firing Guilfoyle. The MAGA leader has made a fortune while in the White House, but Roginsky argued he only allows those closest to him to partake.'}

{'text': 'Roginsky 講：「只有 Donald Trump 本人，以及同佢真正有血緣關係嘅人——唔計外家，而係指啲仔女——先獲准做呢類嘢，又或者係同啲仔女做生意嘅人，例如 Witkoff 或者 Kushner 家族，呢啲顯而易見。」佢續講：「咁都算好多人啦，對唔對？但就唔包括佢。」', 'paragraph_context': '「Only Donald Trump and people who are actually related to him, not the in-laws, but the kids, are allowed to do things like this, or people who do business with the kids, like the Witkoffs or the Kushners, obviously,」 Roginsky said. 「A lot of people, right? But not her.」'}

{'text': '佢繼續講：「唔包佢，係因為佢已經唔再屬於嗰個圈子。一旦你離開咗核心，你就變成過氣人物，即係可以隨時被棄掉。佢明顯唔明白呢個道理。」', 'paragraph_context': 'She continued, 「Not her, because she wasn』t part of that tribe anymore. And once you』re out of the circle, you』re an ex, which means you』re disposable. And she did not get that memo.」'}

{'text': 'Roginsky 之後補充：「佢一直唔明白，一旦佺失勢，就等於被流放咗去希臘。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Roginsky then added, 「She never understood that once she was out, she was being exiled to Greece.」'}
